usedFor: Drip events like “New Lead” send a chat request to an AI agent in Gtwy through “Call AI Agent Instantly”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead” in Drip, then “Call AI Agent Instantly” in Gtwy
bestTemplate.why: A new lead is a clear trigger, and the action sends a chat request to a chosen AI agent.

watchOut: “Updated Lead Score” fires on every change, so pick “New Lead” for one call per lead.
